s: Shello leyached basar lepesach ubo h' seipim: asur laadam sheyyomar (al behemto): "basar zeh lepesach hu", veen tzarik lomar shello yomar ken al gedi vetaleh, mippene marit haayin, shehashshomea sabur shehu maqdish otam lepesach, veachar kak kesheyyoklem yehe nireh keokel qadashim bachutz. Ella apillu al shum min behema chayya vaop, ben chayyim ben shechutim — lo yomar: "basar zeh lepesach", ella yomar: "basar zeh leyom tob", sheim yomar: "lepesach", yehe hashshomea sabur shemmaqdish habbasar lidme pesach, dehaynu sheyyimkor habbasar veyiqqach pesach bedamayv, veachar kak kesheyyokal hu atzmo et habbasar — yehe nireh kemoel beqadashim. Veken lo yomar adam lishlucho: "helak maot hallalu veqach li bahem basar lepesach", ella yomar: "qach li basar leyom tob":

Abal al dagim veal kol shear debarim sheenan min basar kelal — muttar lomar: "zeh yehe lepesach", shebbevadday lo yehe nidmeh lehashshomea shehu maqdish dabar zeh lidme pesach, kevan sheddabar zeh en lo shayyakut kelal im pesach, shehare enan min basar kelal. Veyesh machamirin shello lomar al shum dabar: "zeh lepesach", chutz min hachittim vekayyotze bahem middebarim hatztzerikim shimmur mechimmutz, shehashshomea shehu omer: "chittim ellu lepesach", yehe sabur sheomer: chittim ellu atzniem veeshmerem mechimmutz letzorek happesach. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla. Abal bediabad, apillu im amar al gedi vetaleh chayyim: "basar zeh lepesach" — muttarim baakila, apillu amar ken beereb pesach achar chatzot, demishshum marit haayin en leesor bediabad. (Veyesh machamirin bigdi vetaleh leosram baakila leolam, ben bepesach ben qodem happesach o acharayv, apillu amar ken al besar gedi vetaleh, shechosheshim lepi shehashshomea shehu omer basar zeh lepesach hu sabur shekkebar hiqdisho mechayyim leshem pesach, vihe nireh keokel qadashim bachutz. Abal muttarim bahanaa, demishshum marit haayin bilbad en oserin bahanaa kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman h'. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem im en sham hepsed merubbeh velo sheat haddechaq. Vekol zeh keshehaggedi vetaleh hen shello, o sheyyesh lo shuttaput bahen, abal im en lo cheleq bahen — en lehachamir kelal, sheen adam oser dabar sheeno shello):

Lo aseru ella lomar: "basar zeh lepesach", abal lomar: "basar zeh al pesach", kemo shehu hamminhag lomar ken bilshon ashkenaz — muttar apillu al gedi vetaleh chayyim, sheen kan chashash marit haayin, sheim haya maqdish otam lepesach — haya lo lomar: "basar zeh lepesach":

Asur laasot gedi o taleh mequllas, dehaynu litzloto (beereb pesach achar chatzot o belel pesach) keshehu shalem (rosho al keraayv veal qirbo) keen tzeliyyat happesach. Vaapillu bediabad asur leoklo belel pesach, ap al pi shello perash: "basar zeh lepesach" (vaapillu tzelao kamma yamim qodem happesach), kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"v, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh:

Lo yomar adam: "kamma torach pesach zeh", ki "rasha mah hu omer? Ma haaboda hazzot lakem" — mah torach zeh lakem. Veakshav en haolam nizharin bazeh, veyesh shellomed alehem zekut, sheeno niqra rasha ella kesheomer: "mah torach zeh" al torach haqrabat happesach, shehi mitzva min hattora, venireh middebarayv shemmitzvot hattora hen alayv letorach, mah sheen ken bizman hazzeh kesheomer al godel hazzehirut vechumrot yeterot: "kamma torach" — en issur baddabar:
